Internet Services We are an Internet Service Provider (ISP) with fully owned and dedicated international gateway and connectivity - providing differentiated and enriched experience of Internet leased line and committed to delivering very efficient and prompt support services while maintaining high reliability and quality of service. Part of our ISP services include Network Connectivity and Operations, Networking & Network Technologies - Long Haul and Access, Networking - Routing & Switching, Internet of Things (IoT), IPv6 Implementation & Training Managed Security Services We are a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) providing all layers of protections from cyber threats and attacks including Web Application Firewall (WAF), DDOS Attack Mitigation System; all supported by our availability of 24x7 Emergency Respose Team with predefined response time and Service Level Agreement (SLA). In addition to these, we also provide solutions and services around physical security enabled by technologies such as IP surveillance and CCTV products. Managed IT and Network Operations We can fully, most effectivey and very reliably manage IT and network operations for customers whose core functions are none of these and don't have inhouse capabiities.
